task1.title: Request for a Change of Appointment
task1.prompt: You recently made an appointment to see a doctor, but you need to change the date and time. Write a letter to the doctor's office. In your letter, explain the reason for the change, suggest a new date and time, and ask if that would be suitable. Be polite and concise while providing the necessary details.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Communication
task2.prompt: In today's world, technology has significantly changed the way we communicate. Some people believe that this development has had a positive impact on our ability to connect with others, while others argue it has led to a decline in face-to-face interactions. Discuss both views and give your opinion on the matter. Include examples to support your argument.
